target.description: Named target under assessment (synthetic or real).

generation_model.description: Runtime generation model claimed by the target.

claimed_invariants.description: Invariant IDs the target declares (e.g. AUTH-01, AUTH-03b). Drives claim_status; independent of checker result.

scope_map.description: Structured scope rows; alternative to scope_decision.

known_bypasses.description: Vendor self-declaration of documented bypasses / out-of-band paths (string list). Distinct from ASA AUTH-08 disclosure files at targets/<target>/disclosures.json (see spec/auth08-disclosures.schema.json).

coverage_boundary.description: Vendor self-declaration of what the profile does and does not cover. Distinct from ASA AUTH-08 disclosure records (kind=coverage_boundary rows in targets/<target>/disclosures.json).

terminal_rules.description: AUTH-07 published terminal rules; values limited to cancel_wins, complete_wins, timeout_wins, restart_wins, failed_wins, reconcile_required
